 Required Skills

title: Copy website and all from given website
desc:
I need the product descriptions from my current website reproduced word-for-word on the new site. Only the text is required—design, images, pricing and SEO fields are outside the scope of this task.

The job involves:  
• Extracting every product description exactly as it appears on the live site, including any HTML tags, bullet points or line breaks.  
• Delivering the copied text in a clean format—either entered directly into the new platform or provided in a CSV/Google Sheet ready for import (whichever you prefer).  

Acceptance criteria  
• Each description must match the source content character-for-character.  
• Spot checks will be run against the original pages before release of payment.

Feel free to use scraping tools or manual copy-paste; accuracy takes priority over method. A quick turnaround is ideal, and I’ll be available to answer questions or verify samples along the way.

title: Instagram & YouTube Stock Market Content
desc:
I need a hands-on partner who can both manage my Instagram and YouTube accounts and build engaging stock market videos entirely from scratch. Your role will start with researching timely market topics, scripting concise explanations, then editing the final “Stock market” videos so they are fast-paced, visually clear, and sized correctly for each platform.

For Instagram you’ll handle feed posts, Reels, Stories, and daily engagement; on YouTube you’ll publish the longer cuts, write SEO-friendly descriptions, and create eye-catching thumbnails. Every piece should feel cohesive across both channels, always reflecting current market moves and my brand voice.

You will:

• Plan a weekly content calendar covering news recaps, trading tips, and evergreen fundamentals  
• Write scripts or bullet outlines, source or design supporting graphics, and record voice-over if needed  
• Edit the footage with clean motion graphics, captions, royalty-free music, and on-screen data pulls  
• Deliver one vertical and one horizontal version of each video, optimized for Instagram and YouTube respectively  
• Track performance in platform analytics and suggest tweaks for higher reach and watch time

Please share links to Instagram or YouTube accounts you currently manage, along with two “stock market” (or similarly data-driven) videos you have edited from scratch. Familiarity with tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and a social scheduler like Hootsuite or Later will be impor

title: Email and File Automation Toolkit
desc:
I’m ready to replace two time-consuming routines—daily email triage and messy download folders—with a single, dependable workflow. Here’s what I need:

1. Email handling automation  
   • Automatically monitor one or more inboxes, identify incoming messages by rule (sender, subject, attachment type, date), and perform actions such as move, label, or forward.  
   • Save attachments straight into the correct folder created by the file-sorting component below.  

2. Smart file sorting  
   • As soon as new files land in a watch folder (from email, downloads, or network share), sort them into a clear folder tree that separates Documents from Media (images & videos) and further sub-organises by date or naming convention we agree on.  
   • Duplicate detection and safe overwrite logic are essential.

I’m open to the toolset—Python (watchdog, imaplib, exchangelib), PowerShell, or a no-code option like Power Automate—as long as it runs reliably on Windows and can be scheduled or triggered in real time.  

Please include:  
• A brief outline of your approach and chosen tech.  
• The runnable script / flow with clear setup instructions.  
• A quick demo (screenshots or short clip) that proves the automation works on sample emails and mixed file types.

I’ll test against a mailbox and a folder packed with PDFs, Word docs, JPEGs, and MP4s; everything should land in its rightful home without manual intervention. Looking forward to streamlining this once and for all.

title: Professional Blog and Website Copy
desc:
I’m updating my site and want a cohesive, professional voice across both the marketing pages and our ongoing content. Specifically, I need:

• Two core pages rewritten: the Home page and the Services page  
• A series of fresh, well-researched blog posts (number to be agreed once we scope topics)

Everything should read crisply and credibly, with clear calls to action and SEO-friendly structure—think logical H1/H2 hierarchy, natural keyword placement, and meta descriptions ready to drop into WordPress. Tone must stay professional throughout, matching an expert B2B audience.

I’ll supply brand guidelines, background on our services, and preliminary keyword lists. Your copy should be original, pass Grammarly and Copyscape checks, and arrive in an editable Google Doc. I’ll review once, send consolidated feedback, and expect a clean final draft after revisions.

If that workflow sounds straightforward, let’s set milestones, lock topics, and get words flowing.

title: Realistic 30-Sec Jedlik Delivery Promo
desc:
I need a tight, 30-second 3D animation that captures the buzz of an IPL evening when every house on one street keeps tapping “Order Now.” In the first beat we see a conventional two-wheeler rider juggling only two food bags per trip; the queue of orders grows, customers frown, and the kitchen dashboard flashes red.  

Cut to the same scene played back with our Jedlik last-mile electric vehicle: one sleek run, the entire street served in a single round. Doors open, steaming meals appear instantly, neighbours exchange smiles and high-fives. The contrast must feel real, energetic and emotionally satisfying—efficiency and customer happiness are the twin messages I want viewers to feel in their gut.

Style & quality  
• Fully realistic 3D look—materials, lighting and motion close to live action.  
• Cinematic but punchy pacing suitable for social feeds and B2B presentations.  
• Subtle graphical overlays (order counter, delivery time) that reinforce the efficiency gain without distracting from the emotion.

Deliverables  
1. Script and storyboard reflecting the IPL-night narrative for sign-off.  
2. All modelling, texturing, animation, lighting and compositing assets.  
3. Final 30-second master in 1080p (mp4) plus clean version for localisation.  
4. Still frames and a 5-second teaser loop for social snippets.

Acceptance  
The promo is approved when the side-by-side before/after clearly shows Jedlik cutting delivery time, and the final shot leaves the viewer with a palpable sens

title: Full CPSR for Essential Oil Blend
desc:
I’m ready to take my essential-oil blend to market and need a Full Cosmetic Product Safety Report to clear the final regulatory hurdle. I have the full formulation, each ingredient’s safety data, and the recommended usage instructions prepared and will forward them straight away.

Using that material, please compile Part A (toxicological profile, exposure, margins of safety, etc.) and Part B (your professional safety assessment and conclusion) so the file meets current EU/UK Cosmetic Regulation 1223/2009 requirements. If any additional tests or refinements are necessary, list them clearly so I can arrange them without delay.

Deliverables
• CPSR Part A & Part B in PDF format  
• Supporting calculation sheets or software outputs  
• Brief note on any remaining compliance actions

I’m aiming for a turnaround of about two weeks. When you reply, let me know your safety-assessor credentials and a couple of similar reports you have produced so I can move forward quickly.

title: AI Agent for MARG ERP
desc:
I need an AI-driven assistant that can sit on top of MARG ERP, listen to customers in real time, convert their spoken orders into data, and post those orders as Sale Challans through the standard human UI. The same agent must also be able to pull the resulting numbers from the Sales Invoicing and Reporting modules so that daily summaries can be produced automatically.

Key points you should know  
• Input method: voice only—no manual typing should be required once the call begins.  
• Interaction layer: the agent must navigate the existing windows and dialog boxes of MARG ERP exactly as a person would, not through database back-doors, so screen-automation reliability is critical.  
• Core scope: create, save, and confirm Sale Challans; generate the corresponding sales report on demand or at scheduled intervals.  
• Extensibility: design the workflow so that additional inventory or analytics automations can be plugged in later with minimal re-work.

Deliverables  
1. Fully functioning AI agent installed on one workstation and demonstrated end-to-end: voice call → Sale Challan saved → report exported.  
2. Setup script or step-by-step install guide.  
3. Brief user cheat-sheet for our operators.

I’m flexible on the underlying stack—whether you prefer GPT-4, Dialogflow, or Watson—as long as latency is low and accuracy in recognising Indian names and product codes is high. Show me a short proof-of-concept clip or live demo and we can move quickly to full roll-out.

title: Format & Publish Story on Wix
desc:
I have a 5,800-word fictional short story ready to go live on my Wix site. All the fonts are already chosen and embedded in the document, and I want the piece to appear online exactly as it reads now—one continuous flow, no chapter breaks, no new styles introduced.

What I need from you:  
• Recreate the story inside my Wix editor, preserving every font change, size shift, and emphasis.  
• Make sure the layout scales cleanly on desktop and mobile.  
• Set up the page URL, basic SEO title/description, and enable comments.  
• Send me a preview link; I’ll do one round of revision notes if needed before we hit Publish.

You’ll get the final Word/Google Doc, the font files (if Wix needs them uploaded), and access to my site as a Contributor. Once the live link matches the original formatting, the job’s done.

title: 1-Day Excel Sales Report
desc:
I have a set of sales figures ready to go and I need them turned into a clean, easy-to-use workbook within 24 hours. The core goal is straightforward data management: enter the raw numbers, format the sheets for readability, and embed the key formulas—SUM, IF, and VLOOKUP—so I can spot totals and lookups instantly.  

Once everything is structured, create a simple pivot-table report that summarises sales by product, date, and any other obvious dimension that helps me track performance at a glance. Please work in Microsoft Excel (desktop) and keep the file compatible with Office 2016+.

Deliverables:  
• Neatly formatted data sheet with my existing sales data  
• Tested formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP) in place  
• Pivot-table sales report on its own tab  
• Short hand-off note explaining your steps and any assumptions  

I’ll be available online for quick answers so you can meet the one-day turnaround.

title: Ongoing Tech AI Reel Editor
desc:
I post daily, bite-sized tech-and-AI lessons on Instagram and need someone to turn my raw footage into scroll-stopping reels. The goal is clarity and speed: one polished, educational reel every day for the next 30 days—30 reels total. If we work well together this can become a long-term gig.

Here’s the creative brief

• Tone: educational and informative, aimed at tech-curious viewers.  
• Look: no fixed brand kit, so feel free to experiment with modern, engaging visuals that fit the topic.  
• Audio: rely mainly on punchy sound effects and crisp on-screen text cues; choose background music only when it truly adds value.  

Deliverables

• 30 vertical 9:16 reels (1080×1920, under 60 s) ready for Instagram.  
• Hard-coded captions, dynamic cuts, light motion graphics, and clear text overlays.  
• Daily delivery via a shared Drive link so I can keep my posting streak.  
• Up to two small tweaks per reel within 24 h of submission.

I can release ₹200 for each approved reel, paid daily as we go. Use whichever tool you’re fastest in—CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, etc.—as long as the final files are sharp and lightweight.

Send a couple of samples that match this style and let me know when you can start; the first clip is ready for you today.

title: Craft Full-Time Finance Vacancy
desc:
I’m getting ready to bring a new full-time professional into my finance team and I need a polished vacancy announcement that will attract the right talent the first time.  

Here’s what I’m after: once I share my rough notes about the role, you’ll turn them into a clear, engaging job ad that highlights the position’s mission, day-to-day responsibilities, required credentials, and the growth opportunities we offer. The copy must read naturally to finance specialists while staying inclusive and compliant with standard employment-ad guidelines.  

Must-haves  
• A single-page announcement formatted for quick posting on LinkedIn, Indeed, and our company site (Word + PDF).  
• Three attention-grabbing headline options so we can A/B test.  
• A set of social snippets (≈50 words each) that we can drop into Twitter, Facebook, and internal newsletters.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Tone matches professional finance culture yet feels welcoming.  
• Keywords for common finance roles woven in without stuffing—think “risk analysis,” “financial reporting,” “regulatory compliance.”  
• Delivered ready-to-publish within two business days of receiving my notes; one revision round included.  

If you’ve written job ads for the finance industry before and can show samples, I’d love to see them. Looking forward to collaborating and launching this announcement quickly.

title: 20-Minute 2D Animated Kids Series
desc:
I have a ready-to-record script and five recurring characters that need to leap off the page in a vibrant 20-minute 2D episode. The story is written for young children, so colour, clarity and gentle humour are key.  

What I need from you is the complete production pipeline: smooth 2D animation, lively voice acting for all principal and incidental roles, background music that keeps the energy moving, and playful sound effects that hit the comedic beats. Whether you prefer Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, After Effects or another 2D tool set, I only ask that the final master be delivered in 1080p (25 fps) with a clean stereo mix.

To keep us aligned, here are the concrete deliverables:  
• Storyboard and animatic for approval before full production  
• Final 20-minute 2D animation featuring the five main characters, rendered and composited  
• Full audio package: voice tracks, mixed background score, synced SFX, and the final mastered track embedded in the video  
• Separate stems for voices, music and effects for any future dubbing  

Once I approve the animatic, we can set milestones for rough cut, polished cut and final master. I’m after a collaborator who can balance creative flair with the technical polish kids’ content demands, so if this sounds like your wheelhouse I’d love to see examples of similar 2D children’s work and hear how you’d bring these characters to life.

title: Commercial Property Leasing Agent – Moga, Punjab, India
desc:
We are the owner of a commercial property in Moga, Punjab and are looking for an experienced commercial real-estate leasing agent / broker / lead-generation professional to help us find a suitable corporate tenant.

This is a success-based assignment. We are not looking for someone simply to post property listings. The objective is to identify, approach and convert genuine corporate tenants.

Scope of Work

The selected freelancer will be expected to:

-Promote the property across relevant commercial real-estate portals, LinkedIn, Facebook/property groups and other suitable channels.
-Identify companies that may be looking for commercial space in Moga and nearby areas.
-Target corporate occupiers such as banks, NBFCs, insurance companies, healthcare/diagnostic companies, telecom companies, retail chains, QSRs, offices, logistics companies, automobile companies and other established businesses.
-Identify relevant decision-makers such as Expansion, Administration, Facilities, Real Estate, Procurement or Branch Development personnel.
-Contact prospective tenants through email, LinkedIn, phone/WhatsApp and other legitimate channels.
-Approach local and regional commercial-property brokers who may have tenant requirements.
-Generate and maintain a database of potential tenants and their requirements.
-Qualify leads and coordinate introductions/site visits with us.
-Assist with commercial discussions and follow-up until the deal is concluded.

This is a success-fee-only assignment.

title: Automated AI Support for PHP Site
desc:
My PHP-based site needs an AI layer that can step in as the first line of customer support. The goal is for the chatbot to recognise routine questions, search our existing FAQ/knowledge base, and deliver a clear, formally-worded reply without any human involvement. Whenever the issue goes beyond its scope, it must hand the conversation to a live agent through the hand-off endpoint we already use for Zendesk.

Key points you will tackle include flowing the OpenAI (or comparable) API into our current PHP 8 and MySQL stack, mapping intents to the FAQ entries I will supply, and keeping full conversation logs so my team can refine prompts later. The bot’s tone must stay formal at all times, with templated greetings and closings I will provide.

Deliverables  
• PHP classes and front-end snippet that embed the chat widget and connect to the chosen LLM API  
• JSON or SQL seed file linking intents to answers, ready for rapid re-training  
• Fail-safe that detects a confidence drop or a “no match” state and triggers the existing Zendesk transfer hook  
• Brief hand-over document covering install steps, environment variables, and how to add new FAQ pairs

Acceptance criteria: in staging, the bot correctly answers at least 80 % of the supplied FAQ set and passes five scripted “escalation” tests by routing them to a human agent.

title: Android Ludo Game Build
desc:
I need a complete Ludo game built specifically for Android. Each match should be short— ideally four to five minutes—with a clear score model that declares a winner when the timer runs out. Players must be able to enjoy the game solo against a solid AI as well as online against friends or random opponents; local multiplayer is not required.

Core requirements  
• Google-based sign-in only, no guest mode.  
• Smooth online matchmaking for quick four-player games, plus a private-room option for those who want to share a code with friends.  
• AdMob integrated for interstitials and optional rewarded videos, balanced so gameplay never feels spammy.  
• Clean, modern UI that scales from small phones to large tablets.  
• Final build published to my Google Play Console; I’ll provide all store assets, but you handle the signing, versioning, and rollout.

Deliverables  
1. Production-ready APK/AAB and full Unity (or comparable engine) project files.  
2. Working Google Play Services, including login, cloud save, and real-time multiplayer.  
3. AdMob implementation with test IDs swapped to live IDs just before release.  
4. Simple admin panel or clearly documented JSON config to tweak match time, scoring, and ad frequency.  
5. Brief hand-off guide covering build steps, key store info, and how to update the game.

Acceptance criteria  
• A four-minute test match finishes without crashes on at least three Android API levels (29, 30, 33).

title: Drainage Company Google Ads Campaign
desc:

My only objective is to generate qualified leads, so every decision—from keyword selection to bidding strategy—must focus on phone calls and form fills that turn into booked jobs.

The ads will cover our three core services: emergency drainage call-outs, routine maintenance, and full drainage system installations. Each service needs its own tightly themed ad group, tailored ad copy and relevant extensions so we can appeal directly to homeowners, business owners and property managers alike.

Because you have run successful campaigns for other drainage companies, I expect you to back up your approach with real case studies showing cost-per-lead, conversion rate and overall ROI. I’ll use that evidence to choose the right partner.

If we work together, here is what I’ll need from you:

• A quick audit of my current account (or a fresh build if starting from scratch).  
• Keyword research that balances urgent “blocked drain” terms with longer-cycle installation phrases.  
• Compelling, compliance-friendly ad copy and responsive search ads.  
• Conversion tracking set up in Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for calls, forms and chat.  
• Weekly optimisation: negative keywords, bid adjustments, split-testing, and budget reallocation.  
• Straightforward performance reports every seven days so I can see leads, spend and ROI at a glance.

title: 3D product modeler/rendering artist
desc:
We are looking for an experienced 3D product modeler/rendering artist for ongoing work.

We develop premium homeware, giftware and Judaica products in materials including lucite/acrylic, resin, leather, candles and metal.

For each project, we will generally provide a PDF with dimensions, descriptions, colours/materials and reference images where relevant. You will create an accurate 3D model and high-quality photorealistic renders.

The renders are often used for our website and marketing, so it is extremely important that the product looks realistic and accurately follows the information provided.

For some projects, the model will also be used for manufacturing, so we may occasionally require an STL file.

Typical deliverables:

- High-resolution JPEG
- Transparent PNG
- Editable source 3D file
- STL when required

This is ongoing work, with projects generally agreed at a fixed price per model/project.

Please send examples of your best photorealistic product renders, particularly products featuring acrylic/lucite, resin, glass, leather or metal, together with your typical pricing and turnaround time.

title: MBA Dissertation Literature Review Support
desc:
I have my dissertation’s scope guideline and an approved topic proposal ready to share, and now I want to move quickly into a solid literature review. The dissertation sits squarely in the MBA field, so I’m aiming for sources that speak directly to current management and business practice.  

Your main task will be to search, evaluate, and synthesise the existing work so that the review chapter tells a clear story of how the research question fits into, and advances, the wider MBA conversation. While academic journals and industry reports are certainly useful, I’m especially interested in insights drawn from recent MBA dissertation projects, as they often surface practical frameworks and data that traditional publications overlook.  

What I need from you:  
• A well-structured literature review chapter written in fluent academic English, fully referenced.  
• A concise mapping of each paper or dissertation you use to my specific research objectives, highlighting gaps my study will fill.  
• A final reference list formatted to the required style (I’ll confirm whether APA or Harvard once we start).  

I’ll provide the university guideline, marking rubric, and my proposal as soon as we agree to work together so you can align tone, depth, and structure from day one. If you’ve previously handled MBA dissertations and are comfortable harvesting material from dissertation repositories, JSTOR, EBSCO, and Google Scholar, you’ll be a great fit. title: Responsive React TextUtils App
desc:
I want to ship a fast, lightweight TextUtils web application built with React.js that feels just as smooth on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers. The core tools I need in place are:

• Real-time text transformations: uppercase ↔ lowercase, remove extra spaces, clear text, copy to clipboard  
• Live statistics: word count, character count, and an estimated reading-time indicator  
• Instant preview pane so users can see their formatted text as they type  

The interface has to be clean and modern, leaning on standard HTML, CSS or Tailwind CSS so the layout scales gracefully across all breakpoints. Think subtle animations, intuitive navigation, and a color palette that can easily be expanded to light, dark, or any custom theme later on.

Under the hood, I expect reusable functional components, proper state management (React hooks), and tidy, commented code so future tweaks are painless. Performance matters: lazy-load anything heavy, keep bundle size lean, and make sure clipboard operations and counters are non-blocking.

Deliverables  
1. Full React project (source code) ready to run with npm/yarn start  
2. Build script producing an optimized production bundle  
3. Brief README explaining component structure, available scripts, and how to swap styles/themes  

If something in the spec is unclear, feel free to suggest improvements—the goal is a polished, responsive tool that end users can pick up on any device and instantly understand.

title: Nationwide SEO for Nidraya
desc:
I need an SEO specialist who can secure the top national Google positions for my brand keyword, “Nidraya.” When people type that single word, I want nidraya.com to appear ahead of every other result, including a competing brand currently sharing the name.

To achieve this, start with a full technical and content audit of the site, then refine titles, meta descriptions, schema, and internal linking so every page clearly signals “Nidraya” to Google. From there, build quality, niche-relevant backlinks and craft supporting content that reinforces the brand term across blogs, PR features, and social profiles. Page-speed tuning, mobile friendliness, and structured data must all align with Core Web Vitals.

You’ll work nationally, so local packs are less critical than strong organic and brand SERP presence. I’ll provide access to Google Search Console and Analytics and expect you to track progress with industry tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Moz.

Deliverable milestones  
• Initial audit report with prioritized fixes  
• On-page and technical implementation (staged or live)  
• Off-page authority plan with first wave of links
